gripOrHq.title: Investment Firm
gripOrHq.rulesText: Take [1] from Investment Firm, if it has any bits, at the start of each of your turns. Whenever [1] or more bits are added to your pool, you may put [2] from the bank on Investment Firm for each [1] you choose not to add to your pool. Effects that give you bits at the start of your turn cannot be used this way.
